description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
When you cast this, Dirgur Focusmage triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve Petals of Insight, returning it to your hand
Cast the prepared copy of Braingeyser from exile by paying {U}{U} and unpreparing Dirgur Focusmage
When you cast Braingeyser, Spellweaver Helix triggers, casting a copy of the Extra Turn Sorcery, causing you to gain an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the copy of Braingeyser, causing target player to draw one card.
Repeat each turn.
